summary: Backend and platform software engineer (6+ years, Python) who builds systems that keep themselves running: self-healing automation, distributed storage, asyncio services, PostgreSQL, and CI/CD, with 24/7 on-call against a 99.9% SLA. Outside work, builds Terraform-managed services on Google Cloud.

bullets: Second of 21 contributors over the last year on the satellite gateway automation platform: 491 commits across 67 delivered tickets spanning monitoring, alerting, self-healing, and reporting for five ground-segment platforms

Root-caused and eliminated a platform-wide logging defect that silently discarded log records, cutting the log footprint from 19.68 GB to 58 MB and reclaiming ~25 GB in production; swept all 146 scheduled jobs for the same pattern

Root-caused two production failures: a 738 MB core dump traced with gdb to an unguarded deserialization path in a vendor gateway component, and a 177-process leak traced to a library deadlock at interpreter teardown; delivered both as actionable defect reports and shipped the supervision module that closed the leak

Designed the platform's shared logging entry point, now used by every script and device module; introduced continuous integration to the organization; migrated the action-audit data model with 26,857 rows reconciled exactly

Authored the platform's Kubernetes migration design covering 161 scheduled jobs and made the shared library cluster-ready (stdout log collection, service-DNS database routing, unit-tested), on a Patroni-managed high-availability PostgreSQL pair

Lead analyst on infrastructure failure investigations and 24/7 on-call against a 99.9% availability SLA; rollback owner in formal change control, building incident timelines from core-dump metadata and process logs
